newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor shares recover from Spain setback.
newsitem.headline: Usinor shares recover from Spain setback.

text.p: Shares in French steel group Usinor recovered from their Tuesday losses after disappointment it failed in its bid to buy a 35-percent stake in Spain's Corporacion Siderurgica Intergral (CGI).
At 1131 GMT, Usinor was up 4.05 percent at 123.30 francs after a drop to 118.50 francs on Tuesday from its all-time high of 126.60 francs on Monday.
Usinor has been boosted by its recent entry to the CAC-40 index, which prompted index tracking funds to buy the stock.
Usinor said on Tuesday it would continue its planned strategy of strengthening its market position in Spain, by internal growth or acquisitions.
Luxembourg steel maker Arbed won the bidding for the CSI stake thanks to its plans to increase productivity at the Spanish firm.
